vacancy.title: Work Preparer (Werkvoorbereider) – Space AIT Production
vacancy.location: Oegstgeest, Netherlands (Airbus Defence and Space Netherlands; not ESTEC)
vacancy.assessment: Airbus Netherlands production work-preparer role supporting space hardware AIT in Oegstgeest: plan personnel and facilities, prepare tooling/materials/work instructions, troubleshoot production equipment, coordinate AIT managers and improve processes. Existing machine-project planning and manufacturing experience transfer well, but MBO+ target level and planning/administrative focus are under-level for MSc mechanical engineer; no direct ESTEC placement. One-year deta-vast, possible hybrid, salary unspecified. Official hiring desk shows closing date 14 Dec 2026 and continuous applications until filled.
